summary: Iteration 20 — Per-service SK Insights engine tested. Backend: 21/21 pytest cases passing. Verified 80 blogs (10 per service across 8 services), category filtering, service counts endpoint (all 8×10), single blog reader with 5-6 sections, 3+ takeaways, sk_insight.take + corporate_relevance, 3 related, earlier_editions, archive list + 404 handling, unified /archive with type & theme filters (blog>=80, videos filter to video-only, Technology filter to Technology-only, themes+theme_counts present), and admin auth gating (401 without token, 200 with admin JWT; regenerate was NOT triggered per instructions). Frontend: /insights-hub shows 80 cards, hub-svc-* and hub-cat-* filters narrow the grid correctly (business-strategy→10, category filter reduces further), search box present. Reader /insight/<slug> shows hero, dek, sections, key-takeaways, sk-insight callout, share-bar with all 5 share testids, and 3-card related grid. /archive shows dropdowns (archive-type-select, archive-theme-select), search, and archive-count updates live (142→40 videos→27 Technology). /services/ma-advisory shows service-insights section with exactly 10 cards and 'View all insights' link; no standalone 'AI' branding found. Share-bar present on article reader and strategy-insight reader.
action_items: Review request references the slug 'energy-strategy-hub' for /insight/, /insights/ and /strategy-insights/ readers — no such slug exists in service_blogs, articles, or strategy_insights (the domain is named energy-strategy-hub but no content uses that slug). Testing was performed against real slugs (india-s-bess-inflection-... for service insight, agri-value-chain-scaling for article, growth-that-compounds for strategy). If E1 intended a real slug, ignore — otherwise create/alias that slug.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 6342 lines — should be split into routers by domain (auth, insights, services, admin, archive) for maintainability.
FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated; migrate to lifespan handlers.
In /archive, videos are fetched via curator.library() synchronously inside async endpoint — consider running_in_executor to avoid blocking event loop if RSS call is slow.
